standard_prerequisites.use: The first presents the henselization as a filtered limit of the elementary etale neighbourhoods, and the second descends the impurity to some stage of that limit.

core_obligations: Reduce to an affine neighbourhood of the point and write the henselization as a filtered colimit of the rings of affine elementary etale neighbourhoods (proof lines 4752-4761).
Apply the descent statement for impurities along a filtered limit to obtain the impurity over some elementary etale neighbourhood (proof lines 4762-4763).
proof_roadmap: Affine reduction and the limit description of the henselization (proof lines 4752-4761).
Descent of the impurity to a stage (proof lines 4762-4763).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an impurity presented over the henselization of the base at the point already appears over an elementary etale neighbourhood (statement lines 4743-4750, tag 05J5-adjacent). The proof reduces to an affine neighbourhood, uses the description of the henselization as a filtered colimit of the rings of affine elementary etale neighbourhoods, and applies the descent statement for impurities along a filtered limit. The colimit description and its use are the substance, so the claim is H2.
